'''Baggro''' was a senior [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], Baggro received [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi academy|academy]]. Selected as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Baggro became a [[Jedi Commander|Commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="CWGS" />

Soon after the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle]] at [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], Padawan Baggro joined fellow apprentice [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] as part of Green team in a competition arranged by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Taria Damsin]]. The competition, taking place in the new [[Sublevel nineteen training dojo|Sublevel Nineteen Training Dojo]], ended in a tie. Baggro made it through several stages of the dojo before being defeated in the zero-gravity area. Baggro quickly exited the dojo to wait for the competition to end.<ref name="CWGS" />
